claims.statement: Fiber-uniform successor predicates, exact successor descent, current-state merely inhabited lifts, and merely inhabited finite lifts from all current representatives have constructive mutual implications.
Given function extensionality and current-state mere lifts, accessibility of a source state implies accessibility of its abstract image; no dependent choice or LEM used.
An infinite-branching countdown has explicit lifts of every finite all-Work prefix, but no coherent infinite all-Work lift.
For A_k={m:N | k<=m} with inclusion maps, Lim A is empty whereas Lim ||A|| is inhabited; the natural comparison has no inverse.
